systems.system: Nigerian Education Data Initiative (NEDI) / Nigerian Education Databank
systems.country_label: Nigerian Education Data Initiative (NEDI); Nigerian Education Databank
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education; 25-member Implementation Committee chaired by the minister, with UBEC, NUC, TETFund and other agencies
systems.tiers: intended; to track every student from early childhood to tertiary using the National Identity Number as unique identifier

note: Press release on the inauguration of the NEDI Implementation Committee (published 27 January 2025): the databank is an aim with a roadmap still to be written, and the release does not say what is recorded or who enters it, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
